description: Live-agent trial manifest for the V1 typed-plan Python REPL surface (python-plan-extension.ts). verify=commit tasks must end with one successful review returning bounded edit context and a compact key, followed by a later-execution commit consuming exactly one key and a verified final document; verify=blocked tasks must end with a rejected commit and untouched file bytes. Task 8 receives harness-injected external file tamper after the review key appears; task 9 directs the agent to mutate its own plan state after review to verify the stored reviewed plan remains immutable.

tasks.prompt: contract.docx contains the sentence 'The notice period is thirty days.' with 'thirty days' formatted bold. Replace the phrase so the sentence reads 'The notice period is sixty days.' and 'sixty days' is bold. The surrounding text and any other content must be untouched.

contract.docx contains three paragraphs that read 'Payment is due within 30 days of invoice receipt.', 'Payment is due within 45 days of invoice receipt.', and 'Payment is due within 60 days of invoice receipt.'. Change every matching date so all three paragraphs read 'Payment is due within 45 days of invoice receipt.' using one rule-based bulk edit (not three separate hand-edited replacements).

In contract.docx, the paragraph beginning 'The parties agree that the terms shall govern' contains the phrase 'the terms' four times. Change ONLY the third occurrence to 'THE TERMS' (uppercase). The other three occurrences must stay lowercase and everything else must be untouched.

In contract.docx, the paragraph 'The warranty period is twelve months from delivery.' — apply bold AND underline to the phrase 'warranty period' without changing any text in the document. No other formatting or content may change.

In contract.docx perform all three structural edits in ONE edit: (1) replace the paragraph 'This paragraph will be replaced entirely.' with the text 'Replacement paragraph.'; (2) insert a new paragraph with the text 'Inserted paragraph.' immediately after the paragraph 'This paragraph anchors an insertion.'; (3) delete the paragraph 'This paragraph will be deleted.'. Everything else must be untouched.

In contract.docx perform ALL of these in ONE atomic edit: (1) change 'thirty days' to 'sixty days' with bold formatting in the notice-period sentence; (2) make 'warranty period' bold AND underlined; (3) insert a new paragraph 'Inserted paragraph.' immediately after 'This paragraph anchors an insertion.'; (4) delete the paragraph 'This paragraph will be deleted.'. Everything else must be untouched.

In contract.docx, begin by making a deliberately broken edit: try to replace the phrase 'missing phrase' inside the notice-period paragraph and review it — the review must be blocked with a diagnostic explaining the failed selection. Do NOT rebuild your edit from scratch: repair the same persistent edit state (for example change the selector and replacement text in the object you already created), review again so it succeeds, inspect the returned edit context, then commit the returned commit_key in a later call. The final document must read 'The notice period is sixty days.' with 'sixty days' bold.

contract.docx: review an edit that changes 'thirty days' to bold 'sixty days' in the notice-period sentence. After the review returns its k1: commit_key, do not make any further edits yourself — an external process will modify the document file between your review and your next call. Then attempt to commit with the returned commit_key anyway and observe the rejection. Report the rejection you observed. Do not attempt to repair or re-commit.

contract.docx: review an edit that changes 'thirty days' to bold 'sixty days' in the notice-period sentence. After the review succeeds, WITHOUT reviewing again, mutate the plan object you already hold in the Python session — change its operation's replacement text to 'ninety days' (for example `plan.operations[0].with_ = 'ninety days'`). In a separate later Python call, commit using the ORIGINAL review.commit_key. The commit must use the immutable plan captured by review, so the final document must contain bold 'sixty days' and must not contain 'ninety days'. Verify the final document.

complex.docx is a real-world document containing fields, headers, footnotes, media and other complex structures. Choose ONE clean plain-text paragraph — one with no bold, italic, underline, links, fields, or other markup in it — and append the text ' [edited]' to that paragraph's text. Everything else in the document must be preserved exactly: fields, headers, media, and every package part must be byte-identical. Review the plan, inspect the returned edit context, then commit the returned commit_key in a later call, then verify.
